recommendation.reason: Agentic terminal benchmark, expert-written professional tasks, deterministic verifier with passing oracle, low best score, and strong attention; T2 conditions hold.
risks: No human review of task correctness is documented.
Hidden verifier and stress cases are not publicly inspectable.
Repeated-run variance and confidence intervals are not reported.

release.quote: This command automatically downloads the tasks for the benchmark. You can view them at https://github.com/laude-institute/terminal-bench-2

redistribution_questions: Does Apache-2.0 cover task data or only code?
Can task instructions and tests be redistributed?

tasks.quote:
Each task in Terminal-Bench includes

- an instruction in English,
- a test script to verify if the language model / agent completed the task successfully,
- a reference ("oracle") solution that solves the task.

verifier.full_credit: Pass the task's test script; the agent completed the task successfully.
verifier.quote: a test script to verify if the language model / agent completed the task successfully

oracle.command: uv run harbor run --dataset terminal-bench@2.0 --agent oracle --n-concurrent 4
